items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The bass player, Charles Drayton. Bass player, Charles Drayton.

ctx.x: Somewhere along the line. I wish I could be more accurate chronologically about when that happened, but it’s documented somewhere. I read it, even. I recall it, but I don’t know if I was there when Miles was with Benny Carter. Who else was with Benny at that time? I wish I could think of the other, because it was a good trombone section. [Possibly Alton Moore and John "Shorty" Haughton] I enjoyed that trombone section. The bass player, Charles Drayton. Bass player, Charles Drayton.

We can actually look on the [album cover], 'cause we have the album from it. [It] says simply Benny Carter 1944. There’s a picture of you in the trombone section. Fact is, in this particular picture there were four trombones.
